entries.german: äussert dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg seine Freude über die Niederlage der Hussiten u. ermahnt ihn zur Ausdauer. Ad relat. d. Arnesti de Wlassim.
entries.english: He expresses to Ulrich von Rosenberg his joy at the defeat of the Hussites and exhorts him to persevere. By order of the lord, Arnold of Wlassim.
